notes: Separate entry from thermoflo-brand (Wave 12, parent Weil-McLain): own page only, nothing imported from or merged into thermoflo-brand, and no Weil-McLain CP range table imported. Only Building Center Style 2 ships, year-only. Style 1 (CP 5160092) is HELD: no text decode on the page, only a serial image and an ANSI date-code image (standards-date estimation is never encoded). Style 3 (A8602779) is HELD: the page states only that the first three digits represent quarter and year, with no position breakdown in text.

styles.notes: Page positions 1-based: year = 1st two numerical digits. Year value derived from the stated positions, not page-stated for this example.
